decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north-west wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Informative:
The applicant is informed that it is a highway offence for vehicles to cross a public footpath without a formal vehicle crossover.  Further advise can be obtained from the Council Maintainence (Consultancy) on Tel 020 8583 4910 in regards to obtaining a legal crossover.
description: Erection of first floor flank extension to dwellinghouse
